11.name: Single and Ready to Mingle
11.overview: After a season that seemed to usher the group into a new "grown-up" era, many of the Charmers find themselves single or on the brink of breakup. Though businesses are thriving, life after love presents inevitable fractures in friendships and new romances.

11.name: Making Waves
11.overview: Salley hosts a beach party in the hope of getting closer to Craig, but it’s her friend Charley who captures his attention. Austen’s relationship hits a rough patch when Madison reveals a secret to Audrey.

11.name: A Novel Approach
11.overview: Austen’s FOMO for the single life grows as Craig sets his sights on new girl Charley. When the gang gets together for Whitner’s literary-themed birthday, an innocent comment about a hot tub threatens to destroy a friendship.

11.name: A Moveable Beast
11.overview: As Whitner’s literary-themed party continues, Craig pushes Shep to reveal a damaging rumor about Austen. Molly takes aim at Salley after dibs are called on more than one guy in the group.

11.name: Loose Lips and Deep Rifts
11.overview: Craig throws his first pool party since his breakup and Austen is a no-show. Salley finds herself in multiple arguments as she spreads deeply personal gossip about Molly and is confronted by Venita about Craig.

11.name: A Medium Rare Apology
11.overview: Patricia hosts her annual guys’ dinner where Austen and Craig see each other for the first time since their explosive fight. Venita continues to warn Salley about Craig’s true intentions.

11.name: Fowl Play
11.overview: Madison hosts a slumber party for the girls while the guys get together for a night out. After buying chickens with Craig, Salley suddenly wonders if she has been friend-zoned as it’s revealed that Charley and Craig are going on a date.

11.name: Engaged in Battle
11.overview: Rodrigo and Tyler throw an engagement party, but it’s Austen’s relationship with Audrey that is the topic of conversation. Charley questions if going on a date with Craig will ruin her friendship with Salley.

11.name: Best Frenemies Forever
11.overview: Craig and Charley go on their first date. Madison offers Venita counsel. Austen’s birthday celebration devolves into an argument that threatens to destroy a friendship.

11.name: Two Truths and a Single Guy
11.overview: The gang heads to Whitner's family farm for an overnight getaway. Austen reveals some news about Audrey, much to Salley's delight. Craig feels frustrated when rumors get in the way of his budding romance with Charley.

11.name: Cabin Fever
11.overview: At Whitner’s family farm, Shep and Craig learn that Austen is keeping them in the dark. The girls struggle to move past the gossip. Madison’s pregnancy takes an unexpected turn.

11.name: Even Further South
11.overview: Shep plans a healing journey to Mexico to try and repair Craig and Austen's friendship, but Venita ends up in the middle of their conflict. Charley asks for a favor that doesn’t go over well.

11.name: Kiss And Tell
11.overview: Salley has her sights set on Austen. Tensions soar after Craig and Charley’s secret kiss is revealed, leading to a confrontation after a night out in Mexico.

11.name: About Last Night
11.overview: The group processes the events of the previous night. Shep takes the group to a healing retreat on their final day in Mexico, hoping to repair broken trust and friendships.

11.name: Carolina Dazed
11.overview: Madison brings baby Teddi home from the hospital. Patricia hosts a Carolina Day party where Craig is confronted by multiple members of the group. Salley voices her feelings to Austen.

11.name: Reunion (1)
11.overview: As the Season 11 reunion kicks off, Salley sheds more light on Charley’s flirtation with Craig.

11.name: Reunion (2)
11.overview: Venita confronts Salley about feeling betrayed; Charley shares an update about her dating status.

12.name: Before We Move On
12.overview: Salley and Austen attempt to define their situationship. Venita hosts a garden party and sets her sights on Whitner, but it’s her old friend Allie who catches his eye instead. Shep reveals details about Allie’s dating history.

12.name: Battle of Whits
12.overview: After rushing to Salley’s defense at the garden party, Madison hosts a gathering where Venita reveals a secret. Allie starts to second guess her upcoming date with Whitner after speaking to the girls. Craig and Whitner attempt to make amends.

overview: Go behind the walls of Charleston, South Carolina's most aristocratic families and discover a world of exclusivity, money and scandal that goes back generations. The fast-paced, drama-filled docu-series follows Charleston singles struggling with the constraints of this tight-knit, posh society.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: In season four, new friendships are tested and old relationships start to sour. Thomas and Kathryn have officially parted ways, leaving Thomas to become Mr. Mom to their two children. Kathryn is focused on rebuilding her life in Charleston. As she approaches her 33rd birthday, Cameran is faced with a decision about pursuing motherhood, all while trying to help Shep live on the straight and narrow. Shep’s protégé, Austen, joins the group and is eager to prove that he is anything but the new Shep. As Craig realizes he’s become the outcast of the group after years of telling half-truths, Landon finally gets her online start-up venture off the ground. In addition to her business, Landon moves to rekindle her friendship with Thomas now that Kathryn is out of the picture, however, getting involved with Thomas means the drama is never far behind.
